doc: The same profile at the float32 latitudes the pipeline passes (lat_back = arcsin(clip(z)) of float32 directions; both poles and the equator first), so degrees, divide, clip and the polynomial all run in float32; tolerance is the golden default for a float32 kernel. Measured: promoting the float32 inputs to float64 changes the output by at most 9.8e-8; one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 1.2e-7 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is 29x the larger of the two spreads.
